sentences.text: Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited. They give economic exposure to the underlying share or ETF but no legal or beneficial rights in it, or against its issuer — no voting rights, no shareholder status.

Robinhood's FAQ says every Stock Token in circulation is backed 1:1 by the underlying, held by its US-based custody partner; its service-providers page names Alpaca Securities LLC as broker and custodian.
Holders can sell on the secondary market, or redeem directly with the issuer where no authorised participant does it for them, after completing the issuer's KYC/AML checks.
Robinhood's product page lists no fee to subscribe, none to redeem in the first 90 days from issuance, and 0.05% to redeem after that.
Not offered to US persons, and restricted in other places, including Canada, the United Kingdom and Switzerland; Robinhood lists the prohibited jurisdictions.
Dividends are not paid out: they raise the token's multiplier, so one token comes to stand for more than one share.
Robinhood publishes the Base Prospectus and Final Terms; the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority approved the Base Prospectus, which Robinhood notes is not an endorsement.
Robinhood lists its Stock Tokens at docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts — a token with the same ticker at another address is not one.

powers.power: Replace the code of every Robinhood Stock Token at once (the beacon's upgradeTo)
Pause every Stock Token at once (the registry's pause)
Block wallets from moving these tokens
Change a token's name and metadata
Grant and revoke every role above

controls.note: Powers a regulated issuer keeps, shown as such, not as a verdict. The Scanner marks these powers in red; for a regulated issuer they are expected — they are still powers over your tokens.

deployer.note: Robinhood's registry deploys every Stock Token from its token-deployer role, so the Scanner does not raise "serial deployer" on a confirmed Stock Token deployed by it.

Stock markets close while DEX pools trade around the clock: a gap from the reference price can open outside market hours.

definitions.rwa: An RWA here is a token an identified issuer issues to stand for a real-world asset (a share, an ETF, a bond or T-bill fund, a commodity fund, a credit or fund share), counted only on evidence — Robinhood's registry and the token's code on the chain, or this site's list of other issuers checked on the chain — never on a name.
definitions.value: Value on chain: the token's supply read on the chain times its DEX price — not the company's market value.
definitions.tvl: TVL in DeFi: USD of the token deposited in DeFi apps on Robinhood Chain (lending markets, vaults), from DefiLlama and matched by symbol — DEX pools are counted under Liquidity instead.
definitions.liquidity: Liquidity: USD in the DEX pools on Robinhood Chain holding the token (each pool's whole reserve), from GeckoTerminal; a pool pairing two RWAs is counted once in any total.
definitions.mcap: Market cap: GeckoTerminal's (CoinGecko's) figure — for an issuer on several chains it is every chain's — and never mixed with the value on chain.
definitions.volume: Volume 24h: DEX trading over the last 24 hours in the pools holding the token (GeckoTerminal).
definitions.premium: Premium or discount: the DEX price against the underlying's own price — Chainlink's feed read on the chain, else Robinhood's quote. Stock markets close while DEX pools trade around the clock.
definitions.connected: Connected tokens: tokens with a DEX pool against an RWA (a memecoin paired with TSLA) — not RWAs, listed apart and never counted.
definitions.stables: Fiat-backed stablecoins are listed apart and not counted as RWAs here — DefiLlama and rwa.xyz count stablecoins apart.
